method: Direct inspection of six-frame contact sheet; not full-video review
observations: Both arms share the sampled prefix. The reference store viewpoint changes little.
The measured arm is already severely ghosted and fragmented at frame 13; structure deteriorates further at frames 38 and 57 and the final sample is largely a featureless blur.
The commanded arm drifts strongly toward the floor but retains recognizable store structure.
The position-error reduction does not establish successful control when the measured output loses scene fidelity.
classification: Severe sampled visual collapse despite reduced positional error; policy failure retained in cohort.
temporal_limitation: Six samples do not resolve oscillation or exact event timing between samples.
